entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2645940376800212096: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 15.9696 +/- 0.0244 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01): 62.62 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -232.900, -187.688 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.758 +/- 0.024 solar radii from Thygesen et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HIP 116454 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..161T/abstract). Mass 0.8 +/- 0.033 solar masses from Thygesen et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HIP 116454 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..161T/abstract). Temperature 5048 +/- 79 K from Thygesen et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HIP 116454 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,048 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe7d1. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,048 K and log g 4.58 (u1 0.644, u2 0.130): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
